scope: Exact-hash source/video visual reward gate only; no processing or integration approval.
limitations: 32 sampled frames cannot guarantee absence of every inter-sample artifact, frame-perfect smoothness, or seamless looping.
observations: The turquoise cup and purple stem/base, mint/pink/yellow scoops, brown chocolate topping, red cherry with stem, yellow spoon and orange crosshatched wafer remain present with the source layout and colors.
Frames 0–60 and 63–123 show gentle repeating lateral rocking/wobbling; toppings move coherently with the cup and settle near the starting arrangement.
No eyes, mouth, face, limbs, duplicated or disappearing components, or frame-edge cropping appear in the 32 inspected samples. White background and framing remain stable.
